texts: The Hippopotamus turns sharply and presses forward again, pushing the Lion toward the water's edge.
The Hippopotamus pushes forward once more, driving the Lion toward the water's edge.
The Hippopotamus drives forward, pressing the Lion back across the grass.
The Hippopotamus drives its bulk forward, pressing the Lion back toward the grass.
The Lion crouches low in the tall grass, watching the Hippopotamus at the water's edge.
The Lion creeps through the grass toward the water's edge, eyes fixed on the Hippopotamus.
The Rhinoceros drives its horn forward, pressing the Lion back across the dust.
The Rhinoceros wheels around and drives its massive frame back toward the Gorilla.
The Lion prowls across the open land, its eyes fixed on the shark at the water's edge.
The Great white shark snaps its jaws toward the Lion from the water's edge.
The Saltwater crocodile lunges sideways, snapping jaws at the water's edge.
The Saltwater crocodile slides backward toward the water's edge, watching the bear closely.
The Grizzly bear approaches the water's edge, head low, eyes fixed on the Saltwater crocodile.
The Grizzly bear's greater length and mass weigh against the Gorilla in the size comparison, pushing the balance toward the bear's side.
